title: Morning Briefing settings — edit ticker and ZIP, then build/upload

stock_symbol.description: A USD ticker such as ARM or MSFT. The board fetches its quote.

zip_code.description: Five-digit US ZIP, preserving leading zeros. Default 92128 is bundled for offline builds; other ZIPs need one build-time lookup.

temperature_unit.description: Display weather in Fahrenheit (F) or Celsius (C).

footer.description: Your footer; an enabled calendar extension can show the next meeting here.

extensions.description: Optional companion projects. Omit this section for the single-screen starter.

calendar.description: Enable the calendar screen and next-meeting footer; requires the companion.

spotify.description: Enable Now Playing; requires the companion and Spotify sign-in.
